summary_1line: Jambavan encourages Hanuman to recall his divine origin and immense powers, urging him to leap the ocean and save the despairing monkey army.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged bear Jambavan stands before the despondent monkey army, pointing toward the distant ocean as he calls on Hanuman seated quietly apart.
Young Hanuman leaps toward the blazing sun in the sky, mistaking it for a fruit, as Indra hurls a thunderbolt that strikes him midair.
The wind-god Vayu cradles the injured child Hanuman while the distressed gods gather around and grant the boy invincible boons.
